svg.title: Wearclair system architecture
svg.desc: Current Wearclair architecture with mobile and web clients, authenticated API, time-series and relational storage, Inngest worker processing, and a separate planned conversational AI extension built on Mastra.
svg.text: From wearable signals to trusted health intelligence
Solid paths are implemented today. Dashed paths identify asynchronous or planned behavior.
Mastra becomes the user-facing intelligence layer.
